entries.en: Mr. Qui'in, I should have turned that evidence in to the proper authorities. You could be more grateful.
Listen, I just saved you from a nasty prison shower scene. Exercise that corporate credit account.
That will be sufficient.
Everyone on this station is chafing under Anoleis' extortion. You might end up a hero.
If necessary, yes. Do what I tell you to, or Anoleis will find what he's looking for.
I had to ask. If you're not willing, here's the evidence.
I'll be back later. You should reconsider.
He gave me what I needed, but with more money.
You refused to testify. Obviously, you hate justice, and deserve this.
He might be corrupt, but he's still the legal authority here.
I've been thinking over your difficulties with Anoleis.
Could you describe the problems again?
I sense a connection there.
Is there anything I can do?
If he's paying them under the table, they're mercenaries. I can kill mercenaries.
A sad tale. Best of luck with that.
So if I help you, you'll help me?
How did you get a pass?
Why didn't Anoleis cancel your pass clearance?
What would you do if you got the evidence?
By "rents," you mean bribes for Anoleis.
Quite so. It is all thanks to you.
With the evidence you recovered, I was able to present my case to the Executive Board.
Mr. Anoleis was asked to submit his resignation. The Board gave me his position. Let's say, out of gratitude.
Now if you don't mind, I have many operations to bring myself up to speed on.
I have not been contacted regarding our arrangement yet. Are things in hand?
Do hurry. Anoleis has many spies.
You're the administrator now?
What are you doing in here?
Not yet. I need to speak to my contact.
You need a pass. How fortuitous.
I'm the manager of the local Synthetic Insights office. For the moment, at least.
I'm trying to find a way into the garage. I have places to go.
New job?
What's this about?
Testify against Anoleis.
I made a deal with Anoleis.
Anoleis would pay more.
You'd be a hero.
Damn right I will.
Take the evidence, then.
The money was good.
You refused to testify.
He's in charge.
About your problem.
Go over it again.
Lorik Qui'in?
Spectre? Me?
Shepard, Alliance Navy.
Anoleis closed SI.
Is something the matter?
Managing the bar today?
An intriguing coincidence.
You mean kickbacks.
We need each other.
You have a problem.
Pass source
Card working
I'm not interested now.
They're crooked.
Leaving Hanshan
What's she doing here?
Is it odd to see a matriarch?
They let commandos in?
Another question.
The blizzard?
Anoleis won't let us leave.
An accident.
Can the crap.
I'm working on it.
I'll give you the evidence.
Males of all species have strange ideas of what asari are like.
It does sound like something that you'd find on an extranet fetish site.... What?
I don't get how a clothed female can be more attractive than a naked one.
If you wish. I will continue to enjoy the bar.
Skip to the part where you tell me what you want, and what you'll give me for it.
I fail to see how this gets me into the garage.
I do. However, there is one other--what is that charming human expression? "Fly in the lotion?"
Violence against Mr. Anoleis' thugs may be necessary. He has members of Hanshan's security team searching my offices.
If you don't mind, I have work to do.
Please see yourself out.
Help yourself to the mints on the table.
I expect I will be testifying in the next few days.
Back again? To laugh, perhaps?
I wish to be alone while waiting for my career to end.
See this drink? This drink is my only friend.
Why, Spectre. I thought you would be cleaning up that nasty business between Anoleis and his secretary.
I suppose not. Still, my goals are met. Anoleis is gone.
Yes, about that. It seems I no longer need it. Don't you agree?
Economics is supply and demand, Spectre. There is no longer a demand for what you supply.
"A verbal contract is not worth the paper it is written on." Still, I value my good name in the business world.
Peevish, I am sure. You are shrewd for a human. I appreciate that.
I can provide 250 credits for, let us say, "document recycling."
I appreciate your help in this matter. Despite the unexpected resolution.
I guess you won't be testifying.
About your evidence...
Not so fast. You promised to pay me if I recovered this evidence.
We had a contract, Mr. Qui'in. I'd hate to think you run the sort of business that breaks contracts when it's convenient.
Really? Because I was wondering how the Board would feel about you wiretapping their administrator.
Then our business is concluded.
So much for testifying.
I still have the evidence.
What about my money?
I guess so.
We made a deal.
I arranged for certain devices to find their way into his office. Purely for my own interest. Synthetic Insights would never tolerate such action.
They recorded many "undocumented credit transfers." The data was transferred to my office.
Ms. Parasini contacted me as she lifted offworld.
The Board will be taking me into protective custody.
How did you get this evidence?
Evidence
I don't need to explain myself to you.
Congratulations.
Glad it worked out for you.
I have to agree.
I have your evidence.
An Internal Affairs investigator contacted me. She wants you to testify against Anoleis.
Guess I can't convince you.
I suppose that's true.
I love wasting my time.
If you haven't changed your mind, I'll leave.
Very fair. Good luck, Mr. Qui'in.
Not as fair as it could be, but it'll do.
You know it's in your best interest to get rid of Anoleis. Here's the evidence.
That sounds like a fair trade.
Just my luck.
True.
Great.
I need to talk to Gianna.
Still being obstinate?
It does.
If that's all you have.
Fine, take it.
An odd answer.
If I have to kill the guards, I'm afraid I can't help you. They're still the law around here.
I'll focus on trying to get your evidence. If I'm lucky, I won't have to fight anyone.
I can't do that.
I'll figure something out.
I would provide a sum of 500 credits. Does that sound fair to you?
We have unfinished business.
Any results?
Well? Are you willing to help me?
Have you changed your mind? Would you speak to Vargas for me?
Excuse me. I need a moment of your time.
The male human at the hotel bar. He is a sales rep for Binary Helix. His name is Rafael Vargas. I need you to speak with him.
I wish I could. I already bungled this myself. He realized I was not a real buyer.
I represent the Aramali City Council on Thessia. Our town is known for its biotic amp crafters.
What's your interest in Binary Helix? They do genetics work.
What is your city's interest in Binary Helix? They do not manufacture amps.
Much of BH's work relates to biotics. There are rumors that the Noveria branch has flown in asari biotics. Powerful ones. Commandos, to be specific.
